storyCards.headline: We Are The World: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Usa For Africa's "We Are The World" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

We Are The World was released in 1985.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
